title: Desktop entry filename displayed instead of the actual program name
line: App launchers on a desktop that uses a custom folder now show and sort by the app's name instead of their .desktop file name.
explanation: Launcher names come from the desktop:/ KIO worker, which reads the Name key of .desktop files, and Folder View only parsed .desktop files when its location was exactly desktop:/. A desktop pointed at any other folder (for example a per-activity folder) therefore labelled and sorted launchers by their file name. The desktop containment now parses .desktop files in any location: the folder model reads each local launcher's Name once when it is listed or changes on disk, keeps it in a per-URL cache, and uses it for the label, the rename field and name sorting; renaming such a launcher edits its Name the way the desktop:/ worker does.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: show app names for launchers in custom folders

Launchers were only labelled with their Name on desktop:/, so a desktop
set to any other folder showed file names. Now the desktop reads Name
once per listed launcher and uses it for labels, sorting and renaming.

BUG: 511746
